expected: A malformed-frontmatter entry should fail with an explicit BL-SCHEMA parse-error diagnostic (file + line/col from the YAML error), not a misleading missing-intents message.
notes: Found during v0.1.61 closure while filing the platform-seam-todo-retirement return; fixed locally by quoting the source scalar. Redaction: no local paths included.
repro: Create a backlog entry with 'source: text (note: more text)' unquoted plus a valid intents[] block; run 'dadaia backlog doctor'. It errors with 'no intents[] declared' instead of a frontmatter-parse error naming the line/column.
symptom: A backlog entry whose frontmatter fails YAML parsing (unquoted colon inside a 'source:' scalar) is reported as 'BL-SCHEMA [slug] no intents[] declared' even though the file declares intents. The real defect (yaml ScannerError 'mapping values are not allowed here') is swallowed.
title: backlog doctor misreports frontmatter YAML parse errors as 'no intents[] declared'
